title: Multiplicative exponent and factor extraction at an irreducible polynomial
statement: Let K be a field and q ∈ K[T] be monic and irreducible. There exists μ : K[T] → ℕ such that μ(1)=0, μ(q)=1, and μ(ab)=μ(a)+μ(b) whenever a and b are nonzero. For every nonzero a, μ(a)=0 if and only if q does not divide a, and there exists a nonzero polynomial a₀ with q not dividing a₀ and a=q^{μ(a)}a₀. No condition on μ(0) is required.
lean_statement: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (q : Polynomial K), q.Monic → Irreducible q → ∃ μ : Polynomial K → ℕ, μ 1 = 0 ∧ μ q = 1 ∧ (∀ a b : Polynomial K, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → μ (a * b) = μ a + μ b) ∧ (∀ a : Polynomial K, a ≠ 0 → (μ a = 0 ↔ ¬ q ∣ a)) ∧ (∀ a : Polynomial K, a ≠ 0 → ∃ a₀ : Polynomial K, a₀ ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ q ∣ a₀ ∧ a = q ^ μ a * a₀)
